message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal public holidays that create “long weekends”** in Canada for the calendar year 2023.  
(If you’re planning trips in a specific province, you’ll want to add that province’s own holidays – many of them also fall on a Monday or Friday and will give you an extra day off.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Typical Long‑Weekend Window | Notes |
|-------------|---------|----------------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1** (Sunday) | New Year’s Day | **Jan 1–3** (Sunday–Tuesday) | New Year’s Day is always a holiday; the weekend is extended automatically. |
| **Feb 20** (Monday) | *Family Day* (Alberta, BC, NB, ON, SK) | **Feb 18–20** (Saturday–Monday) | Only in the provinces listed above. |
| **Apr 7** (Friday) | Good Friday | **Apr 7–9** (Friday–Sunday) | Good Friday is a federal holiday; the weekend is extended. |
| **May 22** (Monday) | Victoria Day | **May 20–22** (Saturday–Monday) | Celebrates the birthday of Queen Victoria; a federal holiday. |
| **Jul 1** (Saturday) | Canada Day | **Jul 1–3** (Saturday–Monday) | Canada Day falls on a weekend; the following Monday is a holiday. |
| **Sep 4** (Monday) | Labour Day | **Sep 2–4** (Saturday–Monday) | Labour Day is a federal holiday. |
| **Oct 9** (Monday) | Thanksgiving | **Oct 7–9** (Saturday–Monday) | Canadian Thanksgiving is a federal holiday. |
| **Nov 11** (Monday) | Remembrance Day | **Nov 9–11** (Saturday–Monday) | Remembrance Day is a federal holiday. |
| **Dec 25** (Monday) | Christmas Day | **Dec 23–25** (Saturday–Monday) | Christmas is a federal holiday. |
| **Dec 26** (Tuesday) | Boxing Day | **Dec 26–28** (Tuesday–Thursday) | Boxing Day is a federal holiday; it gives a 3‑day break if you take the preceding Monday off. |

### Quick Tips for Your App

1. **Province‑Specific Holidays** – If you want a complete list for a particular province, add the following (examples):
   - **St. Patricks’ Day** (Ontario, 17 Mar) – long weekend if it falls on a Friday.
   - **St. John’s Day** (Newfoundland & Labrador, 3 Jun) – long weekend if it falls on a Friday.
   - **Civic Holiday** (most provinces, 1st Monday in August) – long weekend.
   - **Easter Monday** (some provinces, 10 Apr) – long weekend.

2. **API Sources** – For dynamic data, consider using the Canadian government’s public‑holiday API (e.g., https://date.nager.at/Api) or the Canada.ca “Public Holidays” page, which lists all holidays by province.

3. **Calendar Integration** – When adding these dates to a calendar, mark the holiday itself as a non‑working day and optionally highlight the adjacent weekend days to indicate the extended break.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a province‑specific list or any other details!
